title: Non-Descemet Stripping Automated Endothelial Keratoplasty for Bullous Keratopathy in Buphthalmic Eye

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-4.0 International License, Karger); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Phakic bullous keratopathy in a buphthalmic eye (congenital glaucoma, glaucoma surgery in childhood, Haab striae); single case, 39-year-old man

groups.description: Non-Descemet-stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty (nDSAEK) with an 8.0 mm graft (300 um dissection, double-glide insertion, air tamponade) in one eye; topical betamethasone tapered over 6 months

series.baseline_label: Reference = ECD of the donor graft before surgery (Table 1 row 'Before surgery'; Methods: 'The endothelial cell density (ECD) of the graft before surgery'); the counting source is not stated
series.notes: Table 1 column 'ECD, cells/mm2' (single eye; thousands separators removed by the record builder). The '0.5 mo' row is the 2-week visit of Methods (2 x 7/30.4375 months). The '2 mo' row is taken as 2 months from the table label (Results: IOP above 30 mm Hg at around 2 months, same row), although the Methods visit schedule lists 3 months.

exclusions.what: Fellow (right) eye with failed penetrating keratoplasty
exclusions.reason: No ECD time course reported for that eye

notes: Single-patient case report: one individual series (kind 'individual'), standard procedure without an investigational agent, control role.

Methods visit schedule (2 weeks, 1, 3, 6, 12, 18, 24 months) and Table 1 rows (0.5, 1, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24 mo) disagree for the second-month visit; the table row label is used because it identifies the cited cell.
